name: Harry Fox
source:
Little fox child caught a disease called Romus disease. Mother fox remembers a story from old woman that a certain mushroom cures this disease and sets off on a journey to a Shinto shrine where those mushrooms grow.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
